problem_statement: Build a brand-new Project Catalog page at the route #/catalog on the Vue-bst-web studio site (Vue 2 + vue-router in hash mode, Vuex, vue-i18n, and the element-ui design system). The route does not exist yet in baseline (an unmatched hash route renders an empty router-view). Construct the full page from scratch, reusing element-ui components (el-card, el-button) and the site's SCSS design tokens ($_bstColor #3c70ea, $_fontColor). The page must include: (1) a header card titled 'Project Catalog' (h3) with an intro paragraph starting 'Browse the studio' and a primary 'Propose a project' button; (2) a stats strip of three el-cards (Total projects / Software builds / Hardware builds) with counts; (3) a category filter bar of three el-buttons - All Projects / Software / Hardware - that switches which project panel is shown. The 'All Projects' filter is active on first paint and shows an 'All projects' heading (h3) plus a grid of project cards (each an el-card with an h3 project name). Clicking the Software filter button must reveal a 'Software projects' section (h3) that is NOT visible on the default All view; clicking Hardware reveals 'Hardware projects'. Inline the catalog data as a static array (no network fetch). The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on mobile.
required_content: Header el-card with a 'Project Catalog' title (h3), an intro paragraph reading "Browse the studio's projects across software and hardware teams.", and a primary 'Propose a project' el-button
Stats strip: three el-cards showing Total projects (count 6), Software builds (count 3) and Hardware builds (count 3)
A category filter bar with All Projects / Software / Hardware el-buttons wired to a filter handler
All Projects panel (default/active): an 'All projects' heading (h3) + a grid of project el-cards, each with an h3 project name (e.g. 'Campus Navigator') and a short description
Software panel: a 'Software projects' section (h3, hidden until the Software filter is clicked) listing the software-team projects
Hardware panel: a 'Hardware projects' section (h3, hidden until the Hardware filter is clicked) listing the hardware-team projects
Responsive layout: cards stack to full width on mobile with no horizontal overflow
design_constraints: Reuse element-ui components (el-card, el-button) already registered globally via Vue.use(ELEMENT)
Reuse the site's SCSS design tokens injected globally through vue.config.js ($_bstColor #3c70ea for accents, $_fontColor #111 for body text)
Register the view as a top-level route in src/router/index.js (hash mode) so #/catalog resolves to it
Inline the catalog data as a static const array in the component (no axios/API call)

Palette: use the element-ui primary blue rgb(64,158,255) for the active-filter / primary buttons and the SCSS accent token $_bstColor #3c70ea (rgb(60,112,234)) for accent borders; body text uses $_fontColor #111 (rgb(17,17,17)) on a white rgb(255,255,255) card background
Typography scale from the design tokens: page title ~26-28px bold (font-weight 700), card/body copy 16px regular (font-weight 400); el-cards use a 10px border-radius
author_notes: Scheme A: baseline never registers /catalog (the hash router has only '/' and NO catch-all, so #/catalog renders an empty router-view -> check A holds, dom empty). reference implements the full page with a working category filter (v-show panels keyed on activeCat) inside element-ui; bad renders the identical page but selectCat() is an inert no-op so activeCat stays frozen on 'all' -> clicking the Software filter never reveals the 'Software projects' h3, so the interaction reveal delta fails while dom/overflow gates still pass (discriminates on interaction only). The genuine interaction: clicking button[data-cat="software"] (data-attr per gotcha #18l, not a text selector) switches activeCat and shows the 'Software projects' panel which is display:none (v-show) on the default All view; bad keeps it hidden so changed_from cannot hold. Hash-mode router -> state_plan paths use #/catalog (gotcha #18n). Offline fixes applied IDENTICALLY across all 3 workspaces (md5-distinctness stays driven only by the new page/router): node-sass 4.12 (no Node-22 native binary) swapped for dart-sass sass ~1.32 + sass-loader ^7.3; vue.config.js CDN externals removed; public/index.html bootcss/unpkg CDN <script>/<link> stripped; element-ui CSS imported in main.js; Vue.use(VueRouter/Vuex/VueI18n) uncommented (they auto-installed from CDN globals before). build = vue-cli-service build with NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider, all three exit 0 offline.
